Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this game. South Africa take the lead in the three-match series. We move to Ranchi for the 2nd ODI. That match is on the 9th of this month and will start at 1.30 pm IST (8 am GMT). Do join us for the build up. Goodbye!
Heinrich Klaasen is the Player of the Match. He says it was not easy to bat but his experienced and practice helped him. Adds he enjoys batting aginst India but he is happy to win for the team

Temba Bavuma, the skipper of South Africa says it got tight in the end but they stuck to the plans. Adds the pitch was tricky to bat on but David Miller and Heinrich Klaasen did really well. On the bowling, they did well at the start, they lost the momentum in the middle but end of the day they got the results.
...Presentation coming up...

Earlier in the day, after electing to bowl, India had South Africa in trouble at 3 down for not a lot but a superb 100-plus stand between David Miller and Heinrich Klaasen saw them get to the 250-run mark which proved to be enough.

For India, this innings was about two people, Sanju Samson and Shreyas Iyer. It is because of them India got as close as they did. Had the two not played, it could have been an embarrassing loss for the Indians as the top order failed miserably.

The early wickets and the controlled bowling earlier on did the job. The likes of Kagiso Rabada, Wayne Parnell, Keshav Maharaj and Tabraiz Shamsi really pushed India onto the back foot by taking 4 early on. Then there was a fightback from the Indians courtesy Iyer and Samson and then Samson and Thakur. Ngidi though did brilliantly towards the end as he got the important wickets at crucial times which helped his side get over the line.

A solid win in the end for South Africa and much-needed. It though got a lot closer than they would have liked but they'll be happy they held their nerve and managed to take a 1-0 lead in the series. Sanju Samson played a wonderful innings but it went in vain. It could have been a lot more different if he took the strike in the 19th over.
A single to end the entertainment! Great effort by Samson! On middle, tucked to mid-wicket for a single. South Africa win by 9 runs. What a game!
FOUR! This is full and outside off. Samson comes down the track and drives it to long off for a boundary.
DOT BALL! GOLD FOR SHAMSI! Tossed up on middle. Samson slog-sweeps it to deep square leg. Samson denies the single and keeps the strike.
FOUR! Tabraiz Shamsi in tremendous pressure! 15 runs needed now! Tossed up on middle. In the slot again and Samson launches it over the bowler to long on for a boundary.
FOUR! 19 runs needed now! What a thriller this is turning out to be! Flatter, slower and on leg. Samson clears his front leg and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
SIX! GAME ON! The game is not over yet! This is full and in the slot on middle. Samson powers it over mid-wicket for a biggie. 23 runs needed now.
Wide! This is short, slower and down the leg side. Samson fails to pull.
FOUR! This is full and outside off. Ravi Bishnoi heaves but toe ends his shot to third man for a boundary. 30 runs needed in the last over. Sanju Samson in the strike. Tabraiz Shamsi to bowl.

Two wickets for Rabada as well!  Okay, hang on! Ravi Bishnoi starts to walk back but is told to turn back as Kagiso Rabada has overstepped! A length ball, outside off. Ravi Bishnoi mistimes his cut and it goes to cover where Bavuma takes it. A no ball is called and a free hit will follow.
OUT! TAKEN! A length ball, outside off, Avesh Khan swings his bat, It goes more off the top edge and to covers where Temba Bavuma takes a more simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Temba Bavuma b Kagiso Rabada

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and outside off. Avesh swings and misses again.
Dropped! Short of a length and outside off. Khan swings but slices it over point. Lungi Ngidi runs back, gets both hands on it but was stretching to take it. He fumbles and two runs are taken.
Another swing and miss. Length ball, outside off. Khan fails to connect again. Khan needs to just give the strike to Samson. He has already wasted two balls.
On a length and just top of off. Khan has a wild swing but misses.
A potential match-winning over from Ngidi! Two wickets from it! Short and outside off. Samson swings again and misses. 37 runs needed in 12 balls.
Wide! Length ball, way outside off. Samson slashes and misses.
Shorter and on middle. Khan tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust! Superb catch from the skipper! Two in two for Ngidi and South Africa are making a fine comeback! This is full, slow and outside off. Yadav just chips it in the air. It goes to cover where Temba Bavuma runs behind and takes a tumbling catch. Everything depends on Sanju Samson from here on now. Lungi Ngidi is on a Hat-trick. 39 runs needed in 14 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Temba Bavuma b Lungi Ngidi

Commentary.Commentary: OUT! TAKEN! Finally, Thakur goes and South Africa get the much needed wicket! They get a way back in! This is touch fuller and outside off. Thakur drives on the up but fails to get enough elevation to clear mid off. Keshav Maharaj there dives to his left and holds onto it. 39 runs needed in 15 balls. A wonderful came from Shardul Thakur comes to an end.
Commentary.Howout: c Keshav Maharaj b Lungi Ngidi

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and on middle. Samson plays it to long on for one.
FOUR! Poor delivery! A juicy full toss on middle. Samson helps it away past short fine leg for a boundary.
Wide! Sees Samson shuffle across and Ngidi serves this way outside off. Left alone.
FOUR! Three boundaries in the over! Stand and deliver stuff! too short and outside off. Thakur thumps it over mid off for a boundary. 45 runs needed from the last three.
FOUR! Boundaries are flowing now! What a shot this is! On a length and on middle. Thakur scoops it well over fine leg for a boundary.
Short in length, outside off. Thakur plays it straight to extra-cover.
On a length and outside off, pushed to covers for a single.
Outside off, cut to deep point for a single.
FOUR! Thakur is playing a gem of a cameo here. Length ball, outside off. Thakur slaps it over mid off for another boundary. That is three in a row for India.
FOUR! Two in a row! Perfect end to the over! Tad short and on middle. Samson stays back and pulls it hard to deep square leg for four runs. 14 runs off the over.
FOUR! Good shot! Tossed up, on middle. Samson comes down the track and smashes it to long on. The fielder runs to his right, dives and but only gets a hand on it. A boundary.
Fuller ball on middle. Samson drills it to mid on, in the vacant area for a couple.
Another single as this is hit to long on.
On middle, flicked  to square leg for a single.
Full and on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a brace. 2nd fifty for Samson is ODI. He will be key for India to win here.
Length ball, outside off. Thakur punches it straight to covers.
Outside off, guided to third man for a single.
SIX! Samson is key for India to win! Samson pre-meditates and goes back to pull this short ball over mid-wicket for a biggie.
On middle, eased to mid on. Thakur wants a single but is sent back.
This is full and outside off, slower ball. Samson looks to drive but is beaten by the lack of pace.
This is full and outside off. Thakur powers it to deep mid-wicket only for one.
Around off, Thakur guides it to point.
On off, Thakur pushes it towards cover.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and on off, Thakur plays it down to long off for one.
On middle, Samson works it through mid-wicket and takes one.
Fuller and on off, Thakur pushes it to long off for one.
Around off, Thakur plays it through point for one.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
FOUR! Nice and fine! Outside off, Samson waits and then guides it down to the third man fence for a boundary. Second in the over.
Quite short and outside off, Samson cuts but to point.
FOUR! Short and pulled away with ease! On middle, Samson hits it over the mid-wicket fielder and into the fence.
Good length and on off, Samson pushes it towards cover.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one more.

Another loud appeal but turned down! No reviews left! This lands outside off and turns back in. Samson looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. This one seemed a lot closer than the ones that were reviewed.
Shorter and on middle, Thakur pulls it through square leg for one.
Almost! This is frustrating for Shamsi! Samson steps out, he does not get to the pitch of it but swings, the ball turns back in, it goes off the inside edge towards short fine leg for one.
Another single as this is eased down to long off for one.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Wided.
Around off, this is guided to point.
Angled into middle, Thakur looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
On off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Shorter and outside off, Samson slashes at it but misses.
Angled into the pads, Thakur looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Outside off, Samson guides it down to third man for one.

NOT OUT! Going down leg again! South Africa have lost both their reviews now! It is yet again turning too much! It lands on middle and spins back in. Thakur lunges and looks to defend but misses to get hit on the pads. Shamsi puts in a loud appeal but turned down. De Kock starts walking to the other end but Bavuma is convinced to take the review. Not a good idea to take it though.
On middle, Samson works it through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Misfield and a handy boundary! Tossed up on off, this is driven towards mid off. Parnell dives over the ball and it goes through to the fence.
On off, defended.
BONUS RUNS! Down the leg side, turns away further. De Kock fails to take it and Two more runs taken. Wided too.
On off, Thakur pushes it through covers for one.

NOT OUT! That is going down leg! Turning a little too much! On middle, this one turns back in. Thakur looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad. An appeal but turned down. Shamsi wants it to be reviewed and it is taken. Replays show that South Africa lose one.
Short and on middle, Thakur pulls it again through square leg for one.
On the shorter side, Thakur pushes it but to covers.
Shorter and outside off, Thakur slashes but misses.
Around off, Samson guides it through point and takes one.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Shorter and on middle, Samson works it through mid-wicket and takes one.
Outside off, Samson looks to push at it, he does so away from the body. He gets an inside edge onto the leg side for one. The SIREN goes on, Kagiso Rabada has overstepped. Free Hit coming up.
On middle, defended.
Leg bye! On the pads, Samson looks to flick but misses, it hits the pad and rolls behind on the leg side for one. Leg bye.
Another short one, Samson pulls it through square leg and takes one.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
FOUR! Hammered! Two boundaries in a row for Thakur! Short and on the pads, this is pulled wide of the deep square leg fielder and into the fence.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Tickled nice and fine! On the pads, Thakur works it fine on the leg side and this one races away to the fence.
Shorter and outside off, Thakur slashes but misses.

OUT! STRAIGHT TO THE MAN! The stand which was getting South Africa worried has been broken and that could well be the final blow as only the bowling all-rounders to come now. India needed these two to go on for longer. Nervertheless, a superb knock from Iyer. He batted brilliantly but the pressure of dots in recent overs got to him. A short one on middle, Iyer looks to pull, he tries to flat-bat it over mid on but it goes off the splice and to the man at mid on. Kagiso Rabada makes no mistake.
Commentary.Howout: c Kagiso Rabada b Lungi Ngidi

Commentary.Commentary: The pressure of dots got to Iyer! He makes room and this is banged in short. He tries to upper cut it but misses.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it into middle, defended.
Good length and on off, defended.

Another one! On off, this is pushed down to long off for one. Fifty for Iyer. Superb knock from him. He has taken on the South African bowlers here and it has come off. Needs to keep going though, he will know only half the job is done.
Tosses it up on off, Iyer pushes it to covers.
FOUR! Deft touch! Brilliant batting. Just wonderful! Outside off, Iyer waits and then guides it past short third man for a boundary.
On off, defended.
Shorter and on off this one turns away big and also stays low. Iyer looks to cut but misses.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Two more to end! Outside off, Iyer guides it past point and takes two more.
Tip and run! On off, Samson plays it towards cover and gets to the other end.
On off, Iyer pushes it through covers and takes one.
Really good running! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled wide of the deep square leg fielder. Two taken.
Make that 8! On middle, defended.
7 dots in a row now! On middle, Iyer works it to mid-wicket.
Fired in on the pad, Samson looks to flick but misses to get hit on it. A maiden from Keshav Maharaj, an over South Africa needed.
Another one on the stumps, kept out.
Another dot! On middle, defended.
Shorter outside off, this one stays low and spins away. Samson looks to push, it goes off the bottom towards cover.
Big turn again! This lands outside off and spins away a long way. Left alone.
Flatter and on middle, this is pushed through. Samson pushes it back to the bowler.
Two more! Outside off, Iyer guides it past point and takes two. End of another good over for India. 144 more needed.

FOUR! Clipped away! Runs are flowing! Angled into the pads, Iyer flicks it behind square on the leg side for a boundary. This is not good bowling from South Africa. Fifty run stand up between the two. They are reviving hopes here.
Back of a length and on off, Iyer pushes it to covers.
FOUR! Off the outside edge! 100 up for India. 150 more needed now. This is short and outside off, Iyer slashes hard, it flies off the outside edge and down to the third man fence.
Length and on middle, Iyer pushes it to mid on.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for another single.
Shorter in length, Iyer pulls, it goes more off the toe-end towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Around off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Good length and on off, this is pushed to cover.
Bent his back on this one! Shorter and outside off, Samson looks to cut but misses.
More runs! Around off, Samson waits and then guides it past point for two.

FOUR! This is brilliant from Iyer! Another boundary for him. The crowd here is finding its voice back. This is shorter and on off, it is the googly. Iyer picks it, he pushes it with the turn through covers. It races away to the fence.
FOUR! Top stuff! Iyer is on the charge! He steps out again and gets to the pitch of it. Hits it over mid-wicket and into the fence. Momentum shifting now towards India.
FOUR! SHOT! On middle, Iyer goes down on one knee and plays the sweep, he hits it behind square on the leg side and this one races away to the fence.
That is brilliant from Temba Bavuma! On middle, this is played towards short fine leg. Iyer takes off but Bavuma dives to his left and stops it. Saves a run.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
EDGY FOUR! India won't mind how they come as long as they do! Outside off, Iyer slashes at it, it goes off the inside edge past the off pole and down to the fine leg fence.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Wided.
Outside off, left alone.
On off, defended.
More runs! Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for three.
SIX! Over the fence! Samson steps out, he gets to the pitch of it and goes with the turn. Tonks it over the mid-wicket fence. An over India needed. Could this be the momentum shifting over?
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
Iyer steps out again, he does not get to the pitch of it but still swings, gets an inside edge onto the pads.
WIDE! Another wide as this is also down the leg side.
Two more! Shorter and around off, Iyer pushes it through covers and takes two.
FOUR! India need a lot more. They will hope this is the start of something for them! Iyer steps out and gets to the pitch of it. He slams it down the ground and to the long on fence.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Wided.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to cover.

NOT OUT! That is why it was reviewed! Samson had edged it! He survives to fight another day! On middle, Samson looks to flick but he seems to have missed it. An appeal and the finger is raised. Samson reviews immediately. Replays show that he had hit it.
On off, this is pushed towards cover.

OUT! TAKEN! Another one bites the dust! Kishan steps out but the length is shortened. It lands around off and turns back in. Kishan looks to work it on the leg side but it goes off the glove and straight to the leg slip fielder. Janneman Malan makes no mistake.
Commentary.Howout: c Janneman Malan b Keshav Maharaj

Commentary.Commentary: Confusion but no harm done! On off, this is pushed towards cover. The two batters take a start. Bavuma runs to his left and dives but does not stop the ball cleanly. A run in the end.
On middle, Iyer looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
On middle, Kishan works it through mid-wicket for one.
BEATEN! A lovely over comes to an end! This is pushed through. Fuller and outside off. Iyer looks to drive but is beaten.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
WIDE! Big spin but this is down the leg side. Left alone.

OUT! STUMPED! What brilliance from de Kock! That is stunning. Great cricket all around from South Africa. Ruturaj Gaikwad steps out, this is tossed up on leg, Ruturaj Gaikwad does not get to the pitch of it but looks to loft it down the ground. The spin does him in. It turns past the inside edge, de Kock collcts it brilliantly and whips the bails off. He would have been blinded. Shamsi strikes in his first over and India's plan of going after him has backfired. The hosts slip furhter.
Commentary.Howout: st Quinton de Kock b Tabraiz Shamsi

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, defended.
Just out of the reach! On off, Kishan looks to play the reverse sweep but it goes off the glove. Lobs over the fielder at first slip. He runs back and dives forward but it is out of reach.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled towards the right of long on. A run taken.
On middle. Kishan skips down and tries to flick but the ball turns in and balloons towards square leg.
On middle, tucked to mid-wicket.
Lovely delivery! This one is full and outside off, spins back in sharply. Kishan was shaping to sweep but the extra bounce doesn't help Kishan who somehow fends it away in the end.
Length ball, outside off. Kept out.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
On middle. Blocked out.

A direct hit and Ruturaj  was surely a goner! Length ball, outside off, Kishan taps it in front of covers. Kishan calls for a single but then denies it. Ruturaj was halfway down. Keshav Maharaj collects, turns and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. He could've taken a second more...
A length ball on middle. Defended on the deck awkwardly.
FOUR! Change in momentum for India! Another boundary! This is on a length and outside off. Kishan goes back and slaps it through cover-point for a boundary.
A length ball on middle. Kishan blocks it on the off side.
Fuller ball on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Much need boundary for India and for Gaikwad! This is short and outside off, space for Gaikwad to free his arms and play it over point for four runs.
Yet another tidy over from the experienced campaigner. Length ball, outside off. Kishan blocks it out.
Keshav Maharaj is using his experience here! Now angles it away, across the batter. Kishan has a poke at it but misses.
Flatter ball, around off. Kishan fends it away.
This one comes with the arm, around off. Gaikwad works it to point for one.
Touch short and around off. Kishan mistimes his pull shot to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Around off, defended out.
Length ball, outside off. Gaikwad cuts it to deep point for a couple.
Short of a length and angling on middle. Gaikwad looks to pull but misses due to extra pace and bounce. The ball rolls to point. Kishan wants a single but Gaikwad wasn't aware of where the ball is.
Length ball, wide of off. Kishan steers it to third man for a single.
Outside off. Gaikwad runs it down to third man for a single.
Ruturaj Gaikwad 8 runs in 31 balls now. Length and on middle it is tucked to mid-wicket.
Fuller ball on middle. Gaikwad pushes it back to Lungi.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
This is superb from Keshav! Slows it up, full and outside off. Gaikwad looks to defend but misses.
This time Gaikwad tries to defend this full ball but it turns away and beaten him on the outside edge.
This one lands around off and turns away. Gaikwad prods and lets it go.
On middle, clipped to deep mid-wicket for one.

Wide! Similar to the first delivery! this one lands on middle and spins down the leg side. The keeper collects and whips the bails off as Kishan was found off-guarded trying to flick. No bat. Kishan has his back foot in the air but just grounded when the bails are flashed up.
Tossed up, outside off. Kishan chops it past slip and to short third man.
Wide! Shorter and on middle, spinning down the leg side. Kishan leaves it.
On the hips, nudged to mid-wicket for a single.
Touch fuller and around off. Kishan chops it to backward point.
This is wide of off. Gaikwad guides it to third man for a single.
Short of a length and outside off. Gaikwad gets on his toes as he makes a block.
Angles a full ball on middle. Gaikwad again blocks it out.
Length ball, around off. Gaikwad defends on the deck.
Outside off. Ishan blocks it out.
Keshav slows it up and targets the off pole. Gaikwad punches off the back foot through covers for a single.
This one lands outside off and turns away sharply. Gaikwad prods and lets it go.
Fuller ball, around off. Kishan drives it back to the bowler who lets it through for a single.

Not out! This is tossed up, full and outside off. Kishan leans and looks to drive but against the spin. He gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball bounces on the ground and then onto the boots before going to the keeper. Maharaj appeals. It is taken upstairs. The replay shows the ball was well in contact of the ground.
Full and on off, eased to long off for a single.
Around off. Kishan chops it to point.
Three runs! This will give some confidence to him! Length and outside off. Gaikwad punches it through point for three runs.
On middle on a length. Blocked out.
Gaikwad is not having an easy debut till now. On a length and outside off. Gaikwad has a feel for it but misses.
This is short and on middle. Gaikwad evades it well.
A length ball, around leg. Gaikwad makes a bit of room as he tries to flick but gets hit on the pads.
Superb from Parnell! Outside off again, on a length. Kishan chases and tries to cut but misses.
Again in the same channel, outside off. Kishan goes it as he tries to drive but gets an outside edge and the ball falls short of the first slip fielder.
Outside off, on a fuller side, it nips away. Kishan leans into his drive but fails to connect.
A length ball, outside off. Kishan taps it to covers.
FOUR! BIG INSIDE EDGE! A length ball, around off. Kishan gets low to push it away but gets an inside edge past the leg stump and to fine leg for four.
Length ball, outside off, Kishan chops it to backward point.
On middle. This is hit to mid on.
Outside off. Gaikwad shoulders arms to it.
Outside off, guided to third man for a single.
Pitched up, outside off, driven to mid off for a quick single. Temba Bavuma hits the stumps at the bowler's end but Gaikwad was well in.
This is just brilliant from South Africa! A length ball, outside off and straightens off the deck. Gaikwad lunges to push but misses.
On a length and around off, Gaikwad leaves it alone. That was again very close to the pole.
FOUR! After almost 23 balls, India buy some runs! This is full and way outside off. Kishan leans and drives it through point for a boundary.
A huge inswinger, this is full and around off. Kishan gets an inside edge onto the pads as he looks to drive.
This is full and outside off. Kishan prods and shoulders arms to it.
Very full and on off. Kishan jams it out on the off side.
Around off, kept out.

OUT! BOWLED'EM! The dot balls created pressure and Dhawan falls into the pressure! This is top, top bowling from the Africans! This is on a length and outside off. Dhawan tries to play to third man but late swing gets an inside edge onto the stumps. Both the openers are gone now.
On middle, tucked to mid-wicket. Back-to-back-to-back maidens by South Africa.
Excellent stuff from Gaikwad! Length ball, outside off, seams away. Gaikwad has a poke but misses.
Length ball, around off, nipping in. Gaikwad looks to push but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Fuller ball, outside off, Gaikwad is beaten as he looks to drive.
BEATEN! That was very close! A length ball, around off. Gaikwad tries to defend inside the line but misses. The ball bounces just over the middle pole. Superb from Rabada.
Lovely bowling! A length ball, outside off, jags away. Gaikwad has a poke at it but misses.
A maiden! Length ball, outside off. Dhawan knocks it to cover.
Make it five dots in row! On a length and on middle. Dhawan comes down the track and flicks it to square leg. Not off the middle.
Another dot! Four dots in a row! Fuller and outside off, pushed to cover.
A length ball, outside off. Dhawan keeps it out.
A length ball on middle. Dhawan skips down and looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
This is full, angling outside off before shaping away. Dhawan leaves it alone.
Very full and on off. Defended out.
Length ball, outside off. Gaikwad tries to defend inside the line.

OUT! TIMBER! Gill goes for a low score. Rabada keeps bowling in the same channel, this is around the 4th stump channel and it nips in sharply. Gill steps across as he looks to push but gets an inside edge and the ball deflects onto the stumps. Discipline bowling from Kagiso Rabada.
Rabada serves it on a length and outside off. Gill watchfully leaves it.
On middle. Gill defends it out.
Around off, kept out.
Outside off, Dhawan leaves it alone.
This one seams back in, on the pads. Dhawan misses his flick and gets hit on the pads.
Short in length and outside off. Dhawan cuts on the up and over covers for a couple of runs.
On a length and on middle, nips in. Dhawan looks to work on the leg side but is beaten by the late seam movement.
Length and outside off at 130 clicks. Dhawan has a feel for it but misses.
On a length and outside off, tapped to covers.
Wide! Full ball, down the leg side, this one swings very late. Dhawan looks to flick but misses. Wayne Parnell puts up an appeal but the umpire calls it a wide.
Wayne Parnell to bowl from the other end.
FIve runs off the first over. This is outside off. Gill guides it to point.
Pitched up, outside off. Gill punches it sweetly through covers for a couple of runs.
This one is bowled on the pads. Dhawan helps it to fine leg for one more.
On a length and outside off. Dhawan blocks it out.
IN THE AIR AND SAFE! This is full and arounnd off. Gill chips it straight to mid off where Temba Bavuma dives forward and collects just in front of him. The batters cross.
Rabada starts with a length ball, around middle and leg. Dhawan tucks it to mid-wicket for a quick single. India are underway.
